evidence: Matches the Mining label and modifies block template caching logic in src/node/block_template_manager.* and src/rpc/mining.cpp.
rationale: Moves getblocktemplate caching out of function-local statics into BlockTemplateManager to improve lifetime safety and testability. The author notes this resolves lifetime issues where 'cached CBlockIndex* can outlive the ChainstateManager that owns it' in multi-node environments, while adding thread-safety annotations and test coverage for cache rebuild rules.
